start.title: [TODO:ar] Torches in the Trees
start.text:
[TODO:ar] Torchlight floods the olive grove.
Judas leads armed men toward you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The hour will not be hidden from.
[TODO:ar] You step into the torchlight.
[TODO:ar] Not by power, but by surrender.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Not Hidden
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The Father's will must be met openly.
Walk into the light.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You rise to meet them.

angels_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Twelve Legions Wait
angels_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Heaven could rescue you in a breath.
But Scripture must be fulfilled.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You set your face like flint.

judas_arrives.title: [TODO:ar] Friend, Why Have You Come?
judas_arrives.text:
[TODO:ar] Judas walks ahead of the crowd.
His lantern trembles in his hand.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Meet betrayal with grace.
[TODO:ar] Stay. The cup is here.
[TODO:ar] Your voice is soft, unbroken.

shame_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Grace, Not Wrath
shame_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Even now, love is your answer.
Let him hear it once more.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] His eyes break under your gaze.

run_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] The Cup Is Here
run_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] You did not pray all night to flee.
Meet him where you stand.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You hold your ground in peace.

kiss.title: [TODO:ar] A Sign of a Kiss
kiss.text:
[TODO:ar] Judas leans close. "Rabbi."
His lips brush your cheek in betrayal.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] No violence answers this kiss.
[TODO:ar] "Do what you came to do."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Pretend you do not know him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Truth, even now. Especially now.

strike_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Not by the Sword
strike_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Even Judas is loved to the end.
Let the kiss become his witness.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your stillness is louder than wrath.

pretend_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Truth, Even Now
pretend_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Denial is not your way.
Meet him face to face.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You stand fully revealed.

step_forward.title: [TODO:ar] Whom Do You Seek?
step_forward.text:
[TODO:ar] The guards halt at the edge of the light.
Their eyes search the disciples.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Let the disciples be taken too
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Shield them. The hour is yours alone.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Stand silent and let them guess
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Speak. Name yourself.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "I am he. Let these men go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your words fall like a quiet thunder.

let_taken_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Shield Them
let_taken_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Not one of them must be lost tonight.
You drink this cup alone.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "I am he. Let these men go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The guards step back at your voice.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Name Yourself
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Truth must be spoken in the dark.
Declare who you are.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "I am he. Let these men go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The crowd staggers and falls back.

peter_sword.title: [TODO:ar] Peter Draws Steel
peter_sword.text:
[TODO:ar] Peter lifts a sword above his head.
It flashes toward the high priest's servant.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] This is not the kingdom's way.
[TODO:ar] Peter freezes, sword still raised.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Take the sword and fight beside him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The kingdom is not won by blades.

cheer_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Not by Blades
cheer_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Those who live by the sword die by it.
Speak the harder word.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Peter lowers the blade trembling.

fight_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] The Cup, Not the Sword
fight_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The Father's plan needs no defenders.
It needs a willing Son.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your calm halts the night.

heal_ear.title: [TODO:ar] No More of This
heal_ear.text:
[TODO:ar] The servant clutches his bleeding ear.
Fear and pain shake his whole frame.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Walk past him to be arrested
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Even now, mercy. Heal him.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Touch his ear and heal him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Warmth flows. The wound closes.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Curse the men who came for you
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Bless, do not curse, tonight.

walk_past_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Mercy, Always
walk_past_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The last miracle before the cross
belongs to your enemy.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Touch his ear and heal him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] He looks up at you, stunned.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Bless, Not Curse
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Love your enemies, you taught.
Live it now, in the torchlight.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Touch his ear and heal him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The grove falls silent in awe.

disciples_flee.title: [TODO:ar] They All Forsook Him
disciples_flee.text:
[TODO:ar] Your friends turn and run.
Cloaks drop. Footsteps fade into the dark.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Let mercy cover their fear.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Let them go without a word
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You watch them with quiet love.
[TODO:ar] They will return. Forgive them now.

call_back_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Let Them Go
call_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The Shepherd is struck. Sheep scatter.
It was written. It is right.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Let them go without a word
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Their footsteps fade into the night.

curse_friends_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Forgive Them
curse_friends_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] They will weep and return.
Leave the door of love open.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Let them go without a word
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Forgiveness goes ahead of them.

taken_away.title: [TODO:ar] Bound and Led
taken_away.text:
[TODO:ar] Rope tightens around your wrists.
The road to Jerusalem opens ahead.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Walk with peace into the dawn.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Beg to be released one last time
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The yes is already spoken.
[TODO:ar] Your steps are sure and slow.

struggle_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Peace in the Cords
struggle_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] These ropes you have chosen freely.
Wear them like a king.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your head lifts toward the dawn.

beg_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Already Yes
beg_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] In the garden you said your yes.
Let the body follow the heart.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The path is yours to walk.

ending.title: [TODO:ar] Led Toward the Dawn
ending.text:
[TODO:ar] Torches line the road to the city.
You walk in peace toward what comes.
